class.name: GFPointerGestureUtility
class.description: GFPointerGestureUtility: 通用指针手势摘要工具。 把鼠标、触摸和系统手势事件归一为平移、缩放和旋转摘要。 工具只输出数据，不控制 Camera、Control、Node2D 或项目业务对象。

tags.tag: snapshot: Dictionary with active, source, pointer_count, pointer_ids, center, previous_center, pan_delta, scale, rotation_delta, distance, previous_distance, and primary_pointer_id.

member.name: gesture_ended
member.description: 最后一个活动指针释放或 reset_gesture() 清理活动手势时发出。

tags.tag: snapshot: 结束后的手势摘要。
snapshot: Dictionary with active=false and the last known center fields.

member.name: track_mouse
member.description: 是否追踪鼠标拖拽事件。

member.name: track_mouse_wheel
member.description: 是否把鼠标滚轮归一为缩放手势。

member.name: track_gesture_events
member.description: 是否追踪 Godot 提供的 pan / magnify 系统手势事件。

member.name: mouse_button_index
member.description: 鼠标模式下作为拖拽指针的按钮。

member.name: mouse_wheel_zoom_factor
member.description: 鼠标滚轮单步缩放因子。向下滚动会使用该值的倒数。

member.name: minimum_pinch_distance
member.description: 双指距离低于该阈值时不产生缩放因子。

tags.tag: 识别为受追踪手势事件时返回 true。

member.name: get_gesture_snapshot
member.description: 获取最近一次手势摘要。

tags.tag: return: Dictionary with active, source, pointer_count, pointer_ids, center, previous_center, pan_delta, scale, rotation_delta, distance, previous_distance, and primary_pointer_id.

member.name: calculate_gesture
member.signature: static func calculate_gesture( previous_points: Dictionary, current_points: Dictionary, source: StringName = &"pointer", minimum_distance: float = _DEFAULT_MINIMUM_PINCH_DISTANCE ) -> Dictionary:
member.description: 根据上一组和当前组指针位置计算手势摘要。

tags.tag: previous_points: 上一组指针位置，键为 pointer id，值为 Vector2。
current_points: 当前指针位置，键为 pointer id，值为 Vector2。
minimum_distance: 缩放计算的最小安全距离。
previous_points: Dictionary[int, Vector2] previous pointer positions.
current_points: Dictionary[int, Vector2] current pointer positions.
return: Dictionary with active, source, pointer_count, pointer_ids, center, previous_center, pan_delta, scale, rotation_delta, distance, previous_distance, and primary_pointer_id.
